Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue West Triangle, Quezon City 1100 DILG Legal Opinion No. 41 s. 2015 27 OCT 2015 HON. ERNIE M. CENIZA Mayor Municipality of Remedios T. Romualdez Agusan del Norte Dear Mayor Ceniza: This has reference to your letter dated 05 October 2015 requesting the Department's legal opinion on whether or not the Municipal Mayor is absolutely devoid of any authority to designate the Secretary to the Sanggunian as member of the Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) under the provisions of Republic Act No. 9184 or the Government Procurement Reform Act [hereinafter, 'Republic Act No. 9184'1 and its Government Procurement Policy Board (GPPB) relevant issuances. At the outset, may we invite your attention to Section 4 of Republic Act No. 9184 which provides: "SEC 4. Scope and Application.—This Act shall apply to the Procurement of Infrastructure Projects, Goods and Consulting Services. regardless of source of funds. whether local or foreign. by all branches and instrumentalities of government, its departments, offices and agencies, including government-owned and/or-controlled corporations and local government units, subject to the provisions of Commonwealth Act No. 138. Any treaty or international or executive agreement affecting the subject matter of this Act to which the Philippine government is a signatory shall be observed. " (Emphasis Supplied) The Government Procurement Policy Board (GPPB) is the inter-agency body tasked to implement Republic Act No. 9184, its implementing rules and regulations and all other relevant rules and regulations pertaining to public procurementl. The GPPB is supported by its very own Technical Support Office (TSO). One of the supports provided by the TSO to the GPPB is the issuance of non-policy opinions in response to requests by government agencies/procuring entities, and private entities. Section 63.1 (d) of the Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of Republic Act No. 9184.

It appears that the GPPB, through its TSO, already issued NPM 140-2014, which addressed a query similar to the one you posed for our resolution. NPM 140-2014, insofar as pertinent to the herein issue, states: "Based on Section 11.2.3 of the IRR of RA 9184. g Secretary to the Sanggunian cannot be a member of the LGU BAC for the simple reason that the prevision did not. include any member from the local legislative body. Accordingly, a careful reading of Section 11.2.3 of the IRR of RA 9184 shows that BAC members should come from the regular offices under the Office of the Local Chief Executive, and a representative from the end user unit of the procuring entity. " (Emphasis Supplied) Attached is a copy of NPM 140-2014 for your ready reference. Thank you. Ve ly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary Is/17 Copy furnished: DIRECI*OR LILIBETH A.
